verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Bun serves an llms.txt at bun.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes its docs as Markdown links. Its docs are also served as raw Markdown (bun.com/docs.md, plus per-page .md URLs such as /docs/pm/cli/add.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, no first-party documentation describing or promoting agent-oriented docs usage.
